title: How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory
summary: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.
body: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.
summaryZh: V7利用GPT-5.6将散乱的公司文件转化为带有溯源的上下文环境，赋予AI智能体更强大的机构记忆，从而能够胜任复杂的多源企业级工作任务。
